findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 14 in the same format as the Physics 11 chapter practice (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 79 questions numbered 1-79; by section: 14.1 12, 14.2 3, 14.3 20, 14.4 6, 14.5 5, 14.6 4, 14.7 7, 14.8 3, 14.9 4, 14.10 12, 14.11 3.

Covers sections 14.1-14.11 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use values changed from the book's examples and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: T = 2π√(m/k), sinθ ≈ θ, v = ω√(x₀² − x²), T.E = ½mω²x₀², phase difference π between acceleration and displacement, restoring force independent of inertia, microwave ovens at about 2.45 GHz, the receiver (not the station) absorbs energy, Richter scale.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
